rationale: Six attempts observed, all numerically passed, compiled at exactly 32768 B smem, and simulated. Baseline (128,64,64,st=1,sw=0): 2558.09 us / 531.63 MB. Swizzle=16 variants dominate: (64,128,64,st=1,sw=16) 1616.24 us / 269.75 MB; (64,128,32,st=2,sw=16) 1597.23 us / 269.68 MB (best); (64,128,32,st=1,sw=16) 1912.58 us / 269.68 MB. Swizzle=8 points underperform at matched tiles: (64,128,64,st=1,sw=8) 1621.54 us / 320.60 MB and (64,128,32,st=2,sw=8) 1631.28 us / 320.57 MB, both at higher DRAM than the ~269.7 MB floor reached with swizzle=16, so the serpentine panel hypothesis materializes but saturates; larger swizzle is preferable and the traffic term saturates once swizzle=16, leaving pipeline as the discriminative signal (st=2 beats st=1 at matched tile: 1597 vs 1913 us). Keep weights traffic=1.5, pipeline=2, launches=1, footprint=1; keep the 32768-byte portability cap since all compiled runs used exactly 32768 B and lowering it would cut the best region while raising it is not permitted. Keep full tile/stage/swizzle domains (all divide 4096) since six exclusions have not made any subset infeasible and swizzle=[0,4,8,16] is retained per feedback rules. Prior six tuples are excluded, so HiGHS must pick a new point; untried regions include block_M=128 with swizzle=16/8 and stages in {2,3}, larger panel reuse with block_M=128, and block_N=64 with swizzle=16. Next hypothesis: block_M=128 with swizzle=16 and stages in {2,3} may lower simulated latency further via larger serpentine panels plus pipelining; if DRAM stays ~270 MB and latency does not improve, revert weights toward uniform or reduce traffic weight since it is saturated, and consider narrowing swizzle to {8,16}. Proxy is a dimensionless ranking, never microseconds. Validation scope: Metal checks execute the exact source/config/TIR but CUDA binaries are not executed; GB10 values are simulator estimates, not hardware measurements; no global optimality is claimed.
